title: Chapter 391 Monsters Attack The Great Wall
content:
Chapter 391 Monsters Attack The Great Wall

Most of the bugs were blown to pieces before they even got close to the city wall.

But there were always a few that slipped through the net and came near the city wall.

However, the Great Wall had long been coated with a layer of tung oil, making it very smooth.

The bugs simply couldn't climb up.

The swarm of bugs at the foot of the city wall piled up more and more. When a certain number of them accumulated, Wang Shuo ordered again to pour tung oil and shoot a rocket.

In an instant, a raging fire roared and spread, building a flame belt under the city wall.

The bug corpses were burned and crackled, and the flames brought up ashes, covering the entire battlefield.

Apache was not surprised to see this tragic scene.

If the Great Wall was broken through with only the first batch of cannon fodder, wouldn't it be too boring?

So the second wave of attack began.

This time it was some larger beasts.

The monsters did not go out. As monsters with spiritual intelligence, they were used as cannon fodder. Even if there were a large number of monsters, they could not afford to consume them.

The unicorn is the most suitable beast for charging.

An adult unicorn is three meters tall and covered with a layer of hard skin.

After speeding up, the impact force is very huge.

Of course, facing such a thick Great Wall, they can only attack in a suicidal manner.

These cannon fodders are certainly not worthless sacrifices.

From the attack intensity of the soldiers defending the city, the commander of the monster can still roughly judge the strength of the defenders, such as whether the defense equipment is sufficient and the number of soldiers defending the city.

...

The cannon fodder attacked continuously, but none of them posed any threat to the Great Wall.

On the other side of the Great Wall.

It was the humans led by Jin Guozhu against the army of undead led by the Black Dragon King.

The battle here was more intense.

The Black Dragon King needed to fight to support the war, so he chose to start a war under the Great Wall.

At the beginning of the battle, the human army led by Jin Guozhu suffered a fierce attack.

The undead were extremely fierce. Jin Guozhu was obviously the attacker, but at this time he could only parry.

It is hard to tell who will win or lose at the moment.

The first day of the battle soon entered a stalemate phase.

Wang Shuo still felt relaxed.

As long as there are no monsters attacking, no matter how many beasts come, it will be useless.

The battle lasted until the evening, and the monsters did not move out.

Wang Shuo was not sure whether the monsters would attack again at night.

He had to replace the soldiers who had been fighting for a day.

At night, the city wall was brightly lit, and Lapachi saw that he could not gain any advantage at night.

So he stopped the attack.

After all, the night is not so friendly to some species of beasts.

The next morning, Wang Shuo received a reminder from Zhao Bangde.

"Be careful, today, the monsters are going to fight!"

Wang Shuo looked serious.

The monsters will appear today, after all, the beasts were almost consumed yesterday.

There are not so many monsters in the more than 200-kilometer Great Wall, and Wang Shuo's defense area does not face so many.

Standing on the city wall, Wang Shuo has discovered that there are more than a dozen dark gold bosses and a platinum boss on the opposite side.

Platinum bosses correspond to human primary warriors.

Wang Shuo wondered if he had a chance to fight this crocodile platinum boss.

War drums beat and horns blew.

The monsters began to attack in an orderly manner.

Like human soldiers, they understood tactics, and even many monsters had transformed part of their bodies into human form.

After the general attack was launched, bosses of various levels rushed over quickly.

Especially some flying bosses, they flew at low altitudes and brought some smaller but powerful monsters to the city wall.

There were also some elephant monsters, who could throw some gold and dark gold bosses onto the city wall with a flick of their noses.
